t:
Not so long ago, a great battle took place in this world. The mortal people of Sarnaut set the mad Creator, Sarn against the distorted god Architect. Both fell in that fierce battle. The energy released upon their death was so great that it swept through the entire world and materialized as the Well of Souls. The Astral hastily retreated from it, and a new Allod was formed, one that we call Ammer. A few days later, the first Aoidoi came out of the Well of Souls.

The memory of this event awakens in each of us sooner or later. I guess you will remember it later.
r173595.n: How did Aoidoi come to be? Why are we born in this strange place?

r173596.n: Ask for a starter equipment set

t:
Perhaps. Perhaps not. You won’t know unless you try.

I have a minute free. Let’s find out if your soul can sing in tune with the stone.
r173607.n: I’m looking for my Talent. Perhaps it’s sculpture?

r173611.n: Ask to help in battle with the demon

t: Friend, it would be a great honor to fight alongside you! Let us burn the evil!
r173613.n: Ask to help in battle with the demon

t:
Oh dear Nezeb... Yes, a reaver called Whip the Fiery was the bodyguard of preacher Maya Milostina. And she didn't come back either... Now I see why. She must have been kidnapped.

Our hands are tied! We're on a foreign land! Damn it... We must first settle it with the dominae.
For the Light and the Empire!
r173615.n: For the Light and the Empire!

t:
The Secret Paths. The forbidden layer of the Planar Rim. Even Great Mages don't know how to get there. That place is made of so many thin threads and matters that even a slightest interference can wipe out a part of Sarnaut. And maybe even other worlds.

And now Kyros tries to get there. I say "tries" because if he had already succeeded, we wouldn't be speaking to each other right now. I suppose he failed, and instead the portal took him to some other place. Not too far away, I guess. You should ask the dominae about that - we've got to make at least some use of their telepathy.

I think you’re mistaken...

Your maiden is waiting for you on the Isle of Revelation, he he.

The centaurs have reached the Well of Souls and occupied it. As far as I understand, Kyros and his mysterious sorcerer are intending to open up a portal using the energy of the Well.

We should use their portal, too - of course, if we don't stop them before that. But first we will have a horde of centaurs to deal with.

You see, his words make some sense. The inhabitants of Sarnaut really do overuse their gift. Especially that strife between the League and the Empire is driving me mental.

But I'm really not fascinated with the idea of some troubled teenager guarding the Purgatory and deciding whether I should die for good or live on. We need to do something about it. I have an idea... However, we should settle that local issue first.

This allod makes me seasick.

And I have sailed all the three seas left in Sarnaut.
r173756.n: This allod makes me seasick. And I have sailed all the three seas left…

t: The east coast is way too dangerous right now. I can't sent anyone there without an approval from the dominae.

Ha! How about taking that canyon after you've covered yourself in sticky stinky... phew. Let's not get into that. They should have closed that backdoor, anyway.

We have peace, but the Centaurs are not prepared to open the gates of their camp for us. They might let you come in, though. Centaurs respect power. My friend Ancient Moon will show you the way.

I'm sorry I can't keep you company. Too busy. Triquetrum is growing by the hour.
r173761.n: How can I get to the Centaur Camp?

t: As you can see, we made peace with the Centaurs. Both nations believe that we are too small and, how shall I put it, too mortal to be involved in a war for territory.
r173762.n: How are the things going in Triquetrum?

t: Good to see you again, Stormbringer!
r173763.n: Good to see you again, Stormbringer!

r173792.n: Sometimes the Well calls to me as though it wants to tell me…

t: Where would you like to go?
r173808.n: Where would you like to go?

t:
Each Aoidos carries the memory of demons, stranger. We knew that one day we will have to face them, but still their invasion caught us off guard.

The magic of the Well protects this refuge from their claws and fangs. Demons can't enter this place, but anyone who steps outside the barrier will most certainly fall victim to Chaos.

I am just a humble custodian of our residence. If you wish to learn more about our people, you should speak with the dominae.

However, I can tell you something.
This dead fighter wasn't a hunter, but neither was he a demon. His body looks strange...
r173834.n: This dead fighter wasn't a hunter, but neither was he a demon. His…

r173878.n: Tell the fighter to prepare for a counterattack

t:
What am I planning to do? Well, have a cup of coffee, take a bath, listen to Etienne de Blizar's opera... But first I need to survive, because there are much more demons here than I expected. We barely survived the first attack. This place must be feeding them with some kind of power. I can only learn more about that if you helped me sustain that defensive barrier.

I can feel the echo of powerful magic coming from the north. I don't know who's fighting demons down there, but right now I could use help from anyone.
r173930.n: Ask what Eladia plans to do

t:
You must be wondering what I am doing here. Well, just like every one else involved, I am very interested in the legacy of the fallen gods. Coming here in my true incarnation would prompt unnecessary questions, so I'm kind of acting incognito.

I supposed that after Sarn's death demons would break loose, and I was right. So when I noticed a large pack of demons heading toward this place, I joined the demon hunters who were chasing them.

This is it, basically. I would tell you more, but I'm afraid I don't have the time.
The Throne Room of the Dead City changed quite a bit over the summer...
r173932.n: The Throne Room of the Dead City changed quite a bit over the summer...

r173940.n: Try and talk to the stranger

The stranger looks at you in surprise.
r173945.n: The stranger looks at you in surprise.

t: Kyros, my beloved one, is a strong warrior. He forbade me from following him, but now this troubles me, for I can feel he is wounded, and there is no one to help him.
r173972.n: Ask what Aellona is waiting for here

t: Well... Dominae bear a piece of the Creators' memory. We possess our knowledge right from the minute of our birth, and we also feel each other, wherever we are. So, we knew that you were coming. That's why we're just surprised, not shocked.
r173973.n: Ask how Aellona knows about the expedition

t:
Bloodshed. Death. War. You were born on a dark day, Stormbringer, just as predicted.

Kyros, my beloved one, is a strong warrior. He forbade me from following him, but now this troubles me, for I can feel he is wounded, and there is no one to help him.

Telepathy is a gift that I share with other Dominae and with some of my students. No, we can’t read thoughts - just images and emotions, but even that is enough to put two and two together. Cassandra and Epius informed me that you’re on your way.

I’m glad it took you less time to get here than I expected.
r173975.n: Did you know I was coming?

t: My name is Aellona. I am a Domina - it is my title and my great responsibility. Why were you looking for me?
r173976.n: My name is Aellona. I am a Domina - it is my title and my great…

t:
Other Aoidoi do not approve of my passion for battles... But this is not my fault that the Creators chose to endow me with the gift of swordsmanship!

I can see you want to ask many questions. We should go back now and have a conversation over a glass of beer in the Refuge.
r173993.n: Other Aoidoi do not approve of my passion for battles... But this is…

t: We won! It’s time to return to the Refuge.
r173994.n: We won! It’s time to return to the Refuge.

t:
Everybody has sinned. Even Tensess says in his Testament, that "there is no single creature in the world who never violated any virtues. May this not become an obstacle on the way to the enlightenment! Everyone can abandon the old sins and let the Light into their souls by saying: Nay to Evil, I Praise the Light!"

Here you are, you have come and said the words to receive the blessing of the Light. May those who was harmed by you, forgive you, as the Light has long done!

Go in peace!
Right into the city of the stone monsters? Oh my...
Right into the city of the stone monsters? Oh my...

I can supply you with anything you might need to support your Order. The more you contribute to the common cause, the better goods are available for you.

Everything is free but limited in quantity. Make your choice wisely.
May luck be on your side, friend.
r174306.n: May luck be on your side, friend.

t:
Not everyone, but many. Some devote their lives to their gifts and serve their people. Like me. I can see the Threads of Fate. I make predictions by looking at the canvas of the future... I predicted your arrival, Stormbringer, albeit I don't know why you were given that name in my visions.

Some find their vocation in sculpture, for example. The beautiful statues of our city are their work. Each one of us have a Purpose in life. This is the legacy of the Architect.

Don't be afraid of this name. He once was a great and noble god. But then, just like Sarn, he faced darkness which he couldn't handle... and became corrupted.

We can see our path clearly. We all have our purposes, but we live as one.
r174317.n: So each of you has a gift?

t:
There's no point in fighting nature.  We could only wait and patiently arrange the chaos of time into the "arrow of time". We believe our birth was a natural reaction of the universe to a violation of its laws. Our purpose is to heal it. And our reward is life.

You may ask why we don't look combatant, and why we are all stargazers and sorcerers? The reason is that we had no one to fight. We were surprised by this gift - the ability to ignite the fires of war. And only when demons showed up on our doorstep, we realized what it was for.

This is not a simple question, but I'm ready to answer it.

The layer of Creation in which we dwell isn't subject to the laws of nature which control time and space. One of those laws is: time is an arrow which flies from the past into the future. Time is a straight line, and whichever two moments we take, one of them always precedes another. We cannot think of the Universe working any other way... But sometimes, it's possible.

After the death of the two gods, Ammer was born. Time and space were going wild, breaking all the existing laws. Time was spiral; it was a wave, a ripple on water.

And space was... Did you see that Astral storm? It was like the matter of Chaos falling into millions of shining pieces, with lightning bolts cutting through the sky and piercing the reflections of a thousand suns.

We were at the very heart of that storm.

It was a strange time, and we tried to sort it out all on our own. We knew the kernel of Chaos, for Sarn was its father. We knew how to protect our minds from it, for the Architect was our teacher.

Finally, we found balance and emerged from the endless wormhole into real Sarnaut. For you, that process took... less than three months, I assume? For us, it was several decades.
r174319.n: How long have you been here?

t: What do you want to know?
Excellent. Now I need to concentrate...
r174322.n: Tell that demons drank the blood

t:
Great Mage Zayan, the first Historian and the oldest sorcerer who dedicated his life to fixing the consequences of the Cataclysm.

Great Mage Catherina, the forerunner of Technomagic who once lost to Sarn and learned humility.

Klavdia Kalugina, who has an incandescent love for Sarnaut.

Such is the Council’s decision.

We are willing to use the power of the Well if it can save our world. And we know only three people who are strong and wise enough to control it. I’m speaking about two great mages who helped us defeat Sarn and Architect.

You need to understand that the Well of Souls is a source of incredible power that belonged to two deities. The League and the Empire are craving it - I can sense that hunger. We cannot allow such a weapon to be used in their war. But... you will need the power of the Well to fight Kyros.

The Council has made a decision.
r174325.n: Ask about the Council’s decision regarding the Well of Souls.

t:
So it begins...

I can’t say this strange power does not worry me. Everything in our world is bound together by the cycle of life and death, and it’s so rude to disturb it.... It sounds like violation of natural laws. But at the same time, I’m thinking about how practical this power is, and how it can fight demons without fear. We already have one immortal Aoidos among us - Kyros. I wonder if your Gift came from the same place?

About Kyros...
r174327.n: Tell about the Power of Light.

t:
Several of our dominae went to the west. Demons were seen in a dangerous proximity from Polis, and I can feel that something terrible might happen unless we interfere.

First, we must counterattack. Demons are aggressive and primitive, and this plays into their hands right now. If we throw them back from our border, we will win the necessary time. Then your people will arrive, and we will be saved.
r174328.n: How are we going to fight demons?

t: Welcome to Polis. You are welcomed here.
r174330.n: Welcome to Polis. You are welcomed here.

t:
Your deeds may be great but they led the people of Sarnaut to thinking that if you had defeated Nihaz once, you can do this again. Ha!

But there was no first time. The Dark God was running away from boredom, not from death. And the death of his old friend has drawn his attention to your world again... It’s a shame nobody listens to Klavdia. Her connection with Sarnaut is deeper than anyone else’s.
r174341.n: Explain why the people of Sarnaut are ignoring the threat of Nihaz’s arrival.

t:
Well, I should have guessed. Even the brightest of minds can’t take a stand against the masses. Dust fighting dust, year after year, century after century. Fate has given them common enemies, but they still can’t forget their strife. It’s a shame. But this is how our primitive society works.

Except our next enemy can just wipe us all off the face of Sarnaut.

Nihaz is coming.

What are you going to do?
r174342.n: Tell about the stands of the League and the Empire

t: My people call me the Dominus of Creation. May it be so.
r174343.n: My people call me the Dominus of Creation. May it be so.

t:
I think you should help these... Children.

Although it is difficult to stand against your own people, sometimes it's necessary. We were wrong when Citovras and I went after Kyros and almost caused the destruction of the Gift that allows you to rise from the dead.

We were bound by an oath, but now I think perhaps we should have spoken to Kyros and tried to dissuade him.

It saddens me to hear that innocent people suffer from the actions of those who live in the same world as I do.

The inhabitants of Eden do not deserve to be threatened with weapons and have their resources stolen. After all, they didn’t do us any harm, they didn’t even know we existed until recently.
r174347.n: Tell them what you have managed to learn in Eden

Flame is raging in the sacred ring. Sacred food blesses our body and let us become one with the flame. It hurts no more. Outlander eats our food to dance in the flame, like a true Burning Claw!
r174420.n: Flame is raging in the sacred ring. Sacred food blesses our body and…

They... they attacked! Captured everyone! Took them away!..

Of course, I remember you. We are still telling our kids how you knocked the previous chief's head off, the rotten Snap the Riverfolk! We had less trouble since then. Bloop the Riverfolk isn't bad, either, but he's obviously not Smack the Lakefolk. He's got a long way to go. That's why the pirates had no problem capturing them.

If you think the Lakefolk made friends with us right after you killed Snap, think again. If they were a little more flexible, we could fight off the pirates together.

Hello, Outlander! Welcome to our land!

Was Draconids' before. Burning Claw's now!

r174660.n: Our Patron favors us and Outlander!

t:
Everything is bound to come to an end. Old gods become weaker. The Sage, our God Father, is the first to leave this world, and it won't be long before we follow him.

There's no room for magic and miracles in this world. We put more load on humans' shoulders. Their burden gets heavier. But they will manage.

Ah... It is time. The time has come to say goodbye to the Sage.

Greetings to you. I didn't have a chance to bow before you and thank you for your feats. Allow me to use this chance to thank you.

It's a sad night tonight. The Sage is leaving this world.
These lands were devastated during the war with the Leper. Have people won it? Umoir people are mighty... Citovras taught us to respect those who lived through troubles.
r174738.n: These lands were devastated during the war with the Leper. Have people…

t:
Defeat? That's a bit strong. Although that's the way our songwriters will put it. Naah. We're ordinary people. All we did was pray to gods for it to pass.

I have no idea if it was gods' help or someone else's bright actions, but the Leper is fading. The Queen's guards are doing all they can. Not everyone is happy about their presence, you know.
r174766.n: So you managed to defeat the Leper.

t: Look what the wind blew in. Horse people! Fancy that! They're not even corrupted.
r174767.n: Look what the wind blew in. Horse people! Fancy that! They're not even…

t:
No idea how, but Nihaz gained direct control over you. Just like any mystic would do. Or me. The only difference is that Nihaz doesn't need to be near you. He can just show up in your dream, and that's it. You can chain yourself every time you go to bed, huh.

You must temper your mind. Got it? So nobody could get into your stone head! I know a trick or two, but he's a god, and you must seek help of a god. Cautiously! The fewer people know about the weak spot of yours, the better.
A flying horse? It doesn't look good. Have you ever heard about sailplanes? Lightning Bolt? Mana-bike? No?.. How can you be so ignorant?
r174791.n: A flying horse? It doesn't look good. Have you ever heard about…

r174800.n: ...The closer you are to the artifact, the stronger the angst and the…

r174830.n: The portal looks stable for now. How long will it last?

t: Every energy can be directed. Every artifact has a threshold of resistance. If we properly focus the energy output, we might make it...
r174834.n: Ask Imperius if he knows how to surpass the protection.

t: There's so much energy around, the air is buzzing!
r174835.n: There's so much energy around, the air is buzzing!

t:
Oh yes. The closer we were to the artifact, the more unstable they became. Both demonologists and demons. We quickly reached the breaking point. Demons fled in fear, and demonologists... Well, you've seen what happened to them.

The demonic horror made me certain we were on the right track. Fear is atavistic in demons. They got rid of it a long time ago along the process of magic evolution. And the fact that the horror returned in them means... I don't even know what that means.

Alastar and I did all we could to protect the minds of the remaining demons, but... We were all who stayed. And I'm afraid if we fail to do something very soon, there will be nothing to protect. Alastar is holding on and using his last ounce of strength. The magic of Light protects him, an incredibly rare gift for a demon, but no magic is eternal.
r174869.n: Tell him about the expedition members you met earlier.

t:
Oh, what happened next was much worse! Demonologists started going insane. Some of our brothers became paranoid and went into exile. Others stopped ingesting demonic blood. You must be aware of what happens to those who tried the blood and then stopped taking it. It takes over!

I panicked. Demonologists were too proud to blame anything but the stress. But it was an obvious external magical impact. I tried to find the source and discovered a strange magic signature deep in the Citadel. I shared my fears with others, but I was ridiculed.

Luckily, someone took my fears seriously. Demian, a kind man, used all his authority to send an expedition under the guise of searching for ancient artifacts. It was a mistake. The expedition recruited those who never believed in the magical nature of the discord on Sogot.

If I wanted some drama, I would tell you, "The primal Darkness, the most horrible thing in the world!"

But I don't. We don't have enough data or people to start a research, while the Catacombs are infested with shadows. I will try to describe them.

You have already seen how "hospital" the Citadel can be. The atmosphere here was tense from the start. For obvious reasons. But things have become even worse since then.

At first, some demons lost their minds. Just some of them, which is not typical. The whole Sogot's pack was very confused. The thing is, the mood of all demons in a pack is usually synced. Tegorah claimed that he couldn't "feel" the mad creatures, they went out of his power. The general council decided to destroy them. It was the wakeup call they ignored.
r174871.n: What lies in the depths of the Citadel?

t: Glad to see you, although we haven't met.
r174872.n: Glad to see you, although we haven't met.

r174875.n: Tell Alastar that you're ready to go.

r174896.n: ...A half-empty bag. It used to belong to one of the party members.…

r174956.n: The portal looks stable for now. How long will it last?

t:
Tegorah wants to turn the Citadel into a ship - I’m all for that. I’ll even help, and that will help me on several fronts. Should look good on my resume... Elves will their Galleon can go to hell, I have a better plan!

So there’s the Master's Citadel on the Isle of Revelation... See what I mean? Even the name is the same! There’s a lot of stuff in there. Piles of batteries. But what’s more...

Terminus is more of a technomage than a demonologist. I have no idea how he got here. I believe, he investigates ways to refine life power and turn it into magotechnical charges. Demons are kind of cheap labor here.

There he is. The huge aoidos, you can't miss him.
r174971.n: Who is Terminus and where to find him?

t: Take your winged friends and go to the Citadel. Destroy their defense system and kill everyone you see. Have some fun.
Your goblin is missing. There is no body. Considering the Destroyers’ strength and his size, he could’ve simply crumbled into dust. Maybe you can find something we’ve missed.
Unacceptable... Another minute, and they would’ve made it to the Heart!
r175040.n: Unacceptable... Another minute, and they would’ve made it to the Heart!

t: More creatures are coming! We won’t last much longer!
r175099.n: More creatures are coming! We won’t last much longer!

t: Let’s see what we have here...

...The demon beckons you closer as though to whisper in your ear, but instead places a hand on your forehead. You instinctively tense, but the demon exudes no hostility. His hand does not feel warm or cold, or... alive. The next moment you realize that you no longer feel it, and what is more, you have completely lost the sense of your own body. As though neither of you exists separately - there is just one integral "I". Then the demon's consciousness unfolds before you like a book, and a flood of memories overwhelms you. You sense that the demon is hurriedly easing that flow lest you drown in this sea of information.

"The Demonologists crave power, Stormbringer. They wish to draw it from us. We had no choice other than to accept their "help". Without them, we'd have no shelter, and the advocates of Light would have wiped us out. The aoidos are our loyal allies, but they stand no chance against this world... They are like children."

...Tegorah sighs heavily. You see the entire Sogot before you. It takes you a while to realize that you are looking at the allod through the eyes of a flying demon.

"Everything has a price. We pay for their services with our powers and our lives. Both sides are fine with this arrangement. These lives are sacrificed for the good of all others. And yet... With the arrival of the Destroyers and servants of Light, many of us have been dying for nothing."

We don't know where the Destroyers came from. They are demons like us, yet they ignore our appeals. The only thing that drives them is their need to... destroy.

...Tegorah nods silently, and then you feel as though you are falling. For a moment, you think you are going to faint again, but the sensation fades as quickly as it appears. The Archdemon continues to look at you, but this time you begin to distinguish the echoes of emotions in his eyes. One is brighter than others: it's weariness. His weariness burns so bright that you can feel its heat.

Tegorah takes a step back, and the suffocating sensation goes away. The Archdemon bows his head as though apologizing. His voice echoes in your head.

"Forgive me for the inconvenience, Stormbringer. We will have to speak in this manner. These walls have eyes and ears."

The Archdemon bows his head, observing your reaction.

"Your nickname means nothing good. We cling to any good tidings, but the situation appears to be desperate. We have just been informed that the Destroyer broke into the upper platform. There will be slaughter. I will gladly answer any of your questions, but right now my attention is focused on the defense."
r175118.n: The aoidos sent me here to help.

t:
Tegorah stays silent for a while. You can feel a light heat and awful itch. It translates from the demonic mental language as deep irritation. The archdemon seems to be out of sorts.

Nevertheless, his voice sounds extremely polite, although cool, when he starts to speak.

"Stormbringer, you're wondering if there are your enemies amongst us, demons. I can't blame you. I don't know anyone of my kin that matches your description".
r175119.n: Ask if there's a mage or a demon on Sogot that can affect other creatures' mind.

t: Tegorah is silently looking at you. You can feel his inner anger, as if a room were filled with suffocating smoke. However, the demon is holding it together. An intricate hand gesture, and a vial filled with black and blue... substance appears in his hand out of the blue. Tegorah silently hands it to you and turns away.

...Tegorah silently hovers above the floor, absorbed in his thoughts. You feel the aura of power wrapped around the demon, but the power is... unusual. There is no chaos, no destructive energy hidden in it.

Just a strange unshakable confidence, like a crystal rock among the stormy astral. You are surprised to catch yourself bowing your head slightly in the Archdemon's presence. No wonder the demon is the leader of the local pack... If even the mortals sense the aura of his authority.
r175122.n: ...Tegorah silently hovers above the floor, absorbed in his thoughts.…

t: What can I say? We’re in trouble... There isn’t enough food. Whatever is growing here, I’m not putting that in my mouth. We need to get to the Citadel, but hell knows how many demons are between us, and the Aoidoi are probably useless in a fight...
r175142.n: What can I say? We’re in trouble... There isn’t enough food. Whatever…

t: There is a residue of the Destroyers’ deadly power in your body which I can’t do anything about... It’s a miracle you’re still alive. But who knows what it can do to you if we don’t fix this?
So you fired a signal rocket to make all demons come after you. Whose idea was it?
r175221.n: Tell Skulnar about the signal rocket and demons.

Oh, it's awkward to do magic in public, he-he. The aoidos are like kids, gaping at any miracle. You know, it's even cute... Ah, can I help it if a hero is asking for assistance?

Stay right there!

Oh, I know all about “Daddy” and his tricks. Are you sure it’s not a ruse?

At any rate, you have changed our future before. You saved the Skulnar, didn’t you? You did. Saved Kirah? You did. Fooled the Architects in Dane? Yes. Whatever Cassandra says, you can change your destiny. I proved that myself many times.

t:
Ah, you're a "great hero", right?

You must remember how you boarded the Eclipse together with a couple dozen heroes and thrashed the place.

Yes, yes, I was there, keeping you from getting to the upper deck.

Remember my walls of fire? I did fry a couple of "heroes", didn't I?

But you went through anyway, leaving my cold body behind. I spend a long time in the Purgatory! Fortunately, I managed to come back, but not everyone was so lucky. Poor Ignat is still there...

But let bygones be bygones. The Queen commands, and I obey. I'll have to put up with your presence.

From the Queen? Hand it over, it must be something important. Let's see...

"...first of all... don't throw... we'll go to... meddlesome guests... at your discretion... frog..."

Hm, frog...?

Oh, a familiar face. Been a while, eh?

What brings you here? If you're looking for a job, you've come to the right place. We could use a hand.

Did you stop Obrad? What happened to that vampire?

You are right, but it doesn't matter how close this army is. We must be aware of what's happening around us. Perhaps these things are connected. Let's call it a premonition.

Besides, this is Catherina's domain, and her word is law here. And so is mine while I have her confidence. In short, don't argue with me. The sooner you get this done, the better.

I don't care about them, but I have a few questions.

First – why are they here? We had an agreement that they wouldn't set foot on Umoir again.

Second – why did it crash here? Goblins might not be the most skilled astralonauts, but they are not that bad. Something happened here.

Anyway, just find out what happened, . You're an expert in these things.

t: [You toss the journal back and leave.]

[You open the last pages of the diary and read]:

It's day 7 since I became a captain again.

It looks like we spent our last money yesterday, haha. Well, the guys wanted to go to that brothel with the hottest girls! And they had plenty of drinks on offer. But we have no money now. I need to think.

Day 9.

The crew is sober and angry. I've been thinking about ways to make money. No one needs June artifacts anymore. And the Empire no longer buys elven girls! Their clubs hire them now, so everything is voluntary. We tried mining etherium, but an Octulhu almost got us, so not doing that again. I had to think long and hard afterwards, even got a headache.

Day 12.

The guys keep suggesting ideas, each weirder than the last. Build our own allod? Every hobo has one now. Go to the Pirate Bay? They say it's even worse there now. Zirka keeps saying we should've accepted that contract from Korleone. But I promised that... that hero named  that we're done with that sort of thing. And it's too dangerous on Umoir now.

Day 13.

I heard from some elf that there's an island where you can hunt these creatures! What was it... Horse Woods? Drowning Woods? Let's go there.

Day 14.

We went to that island, and true enough, it was swarming with those beasts. We filled the hold to the brim. But that place, Drowsy Woods, is a very strange one. The guys felt something there. It was like someone was whispering. Luring them into the thickets. We cast off quickly. And Grunt, the idiot, said someone had sneaked aboard the ship. The drunkard's seeing things already.

t:
[It looks like the notes in this diary are more than five years old.

You open Harat's diary and read]:

The world has never seen a creature as perfect as a dragon. I have always tried to understand them. Alas, these days dragons are rare...

I have searched for them for many years. I perfected my skills, gained new knowledge. I read manuscripts of long-dead elven magisters in the ruins of allods that were destroyed a long time ago...

Eventually I became the best in my field. I get hired by Great Mages who thirst for their Blood. Dragon blood holds immense power! Someday I'll be able to wield it.

Yesterday I was offered a contract of my dreams. Catherina, the Great Mage of Umoir, charged me with the task of catching two dragons. I know where I'll find what I need. Dragons Soliskar the Wise and Agrus the Callous concealed themselves from human eyes after the well known events that took place in the Dead City. I managed to learn where they went with their dragon army. It's the allod Heart of Fire, their old dwelling and secret refuge.

I have a team. Goblins are despicable creatures that no one would miss. Many of them will die, but it will be enough to set up a trap.

I will track down and catch the dragons! Catherina let me in on her plan and granted me a part of her power. The world has never seen a creature as perfect as a dragon. It would pain me to sacrifice them. I wish there was another way to break the Seal and set the Creator free.

Entries on the final days:

They sent us to this forsaken island, I remember reading about it. No one goes there, absolutely no one. They say things named Tristesse used to live here and they were cursed or something... I know how to set a code lock or fix a generator, but catch beasts... I need to get away from these idiots in one piece...

Next entry:

We found Jo dead. He was pale as snow. I have no idea who could have even done it.

Next entry:

Zyrka also didn’t make it through the night. The entire team awoke to terrible screams. Had the entrance to the hold barricaded shut. Someone is hiding in there. And it’s no beast. We're flying back to Umoir, maybe they’ll help us there.

Awoke to screams on the lower deck today. Looks like something broke free, and we are steadily losing altitude for some reason. I have nothing to lose, so I’ll try jumping. Maybe the canopies will soften my fall and I’ll survive. Or maybe I’ll die.

t:
It's all very interesting and might help us... But we'll deal with that later. Alas, we have serious problems now.

There's too many undead under our command now, and they... started getting out of control. We should've prepared for such consequences, but we didn't. We handled it ourselves at the Outpost, but no one can protect the villages in the area. I'm too weak, and it's taking all my strength to keep the rest of the undead in check.

They plan to attack the nearest village, so they are gathering on the outskirts... Target the strongest of them – if they fall, the rest will follow. Protect the villages, and I'll stay here and take a break. I'll need to examine the crash site, perhaps you missed something. Once you're done, find me at the mill. There might be something else we can do.
First tell me what you learned here.

Zayan is a longtime friend. Moreover, if you remember, my house used to live here – on Umoir. I know this allod well.

I gave the reins of leadership over to my Counselor – Rosie de Tristesse, who will now rule what is left of the House de Tristesse in the Patriarch’s Residence. Now I am free and ready to help. Of course, I am no necromancer... but no one will refuse good advice.

t: My dear friend! I have not forgotten your help.
r175527.n: My dear friend! I have not forgotten your help.

t: You can take rest, but every day counts. Go.

Then listen up. Things didn’t work out with the vampires, but we've already come a long way with our army of undead. Let's go even further. Ordinary zombies are good, but there are more powerful creatures. Ethereal, nearly invulnerable and very dangerous. Ghosts.

However, they have certain challenges. In most cases, ghosts are magical beings created by complex spells, when the Spark of a creature that was recently alive is somehow bent to the will of a necromancer...

I’m not Tep, and I don’t intend to harvest from the living by stealing their Sparks...

But luckily, we know a place with a lot of ghosts. They are essentially ownerless. I’m talking about the Show on Gipat.

Delmon told me that you conducted certain... investigations there. You found out that Nihaz was behind all this. He used the Light magic to enslave their will, entangling and pulling them like a puppeteer manipulating miserable marionettes.

I think this is a good chance now to hit his weak spot. For some reason, Gipat is very valuable to him. After all, he did bear the name Gorislav Gipatsky...

You and Dakkar can gain control of these ghosts for us. And the second part of Urd’s journal that you found will help.
I can't even imagine how you must feel. Anyway, after everything you've seen in your life... You’ll cope with this too. But we need to move on. Let me know when you are ready.
r175544.n: I talked to Roxane. I am... a vampire.

t:
Great news. That means we truly have done all we can.

You know, it was almost easy. I thought it would be harder. It seems Nihaz is waiting for us to make the first move. Well. We won’t disappoint him!

Cosmos has already arrived here on Umoir. He wants to be sure everything is in order. Go and report to him that the army is ready.
r175546.n: Wigo fled Amaranth. The vampires will join us, Zayan.

t:
That’s a good question, which I only have a partial answer to.

Each of the keys corresponds to a certain astral element and, besides that, a certain force.

There are three levels of force. Elemental – fire, air, water, earth. Divine –  light, darkness, order, chaos. And the highest are Creator forces – destruction, creation, death and life.

I have the Key of Fire – you already know it as the  Grain of Protopower. The Key of Water is most likely what protected you from the Destroyers. If you didn’t lose it, you must still have it.

I believe the Key of Air was used by us to open one of the Seals. Now it’s destroyed, but both it and the Seal can never be completely annihilated.

The Key of Order is also lost. The Key of Darkness is still in the dungeons on the Wandering Isle, though Tep broke it into pieces and kept a shard.

We acquired the Key of Chaos again just recently. I won’t even risk guessing where the remaining Keys could be.
r175547.n: So, where can we find these Keys now?

t:
Well, why do you think?

Using the Key of Darkness, Tep created his Plague...

And, quite frankly, it was the Keys that broke our world up into allods.

It’s hard to say when exactly the Keys appeared in the world, but it was long before the Cataclysm. I think Nihaz gave them out to those he wanted to control for his own purposes. Remember, he trusted one of the Keys to you – during the events on Kirah.

The Conclave of Great Mages was created precisely when the elves received some of these Keys. We’ve hunted them for a long time. With time, we discovered the Seals themselves. Without understanding what was before us, we decided we could break them up and make even more Keys out of them.

Naturally, that was the purpose of the Great Experiment.

Hmm... The question is, do you need to know?

Fine, I think you did more than enough to earn the right to hear this information.

So, the Keys. As we know now, they are part of the Seal created by Nihaz. You have already encountered them more than once... There should be twelve keys in all. We know about some, but others remain lost.

On its own, a Key can do a lot. After all, it’s a piece of divine power, directly connected to its source in the Seal.
r175549.n: Klavdia said you can give us more details about the Keys...

Orcs, I see... Even before you told me, I remembered something - fire everywhere, smoke obscured my vision, and huge shadows danced around as screams filled the air... I thought I caught a glimpse of a nightmare but then I realized that it had been real. It had all been real...
If the dragons keep on pursuing their own goals and don't make adjustments, it seems that we'll have to remain as ghosts until the end of time. It's alright... I suppose we'll get used to it...
What did I live for? Everything's been in vain!

The elder is to blame, I tell you! He was the one who got us into this! He was up to something, I just know it. That governor is a filthy traitor, too! Ath-Zak made sure he went to hell. Have we ended up in hell, too? Do we have to put up with this hell forever?
I knew I should have left Gipatia. It would have been better to live in the mountains than sit here and do nothing but send the Chosen Ones to fetch my tools over and over. Look how many of them are here! Most of those Chosen Ones are good for nothing. If I had a copper for every one that I saw, I could have bought a palace by now! Oh well...
Spirit of Order heeds your call...

t:
I have calculated the approximate coordinates of Ferris. It wasn't easy, but I did it. But if I'm guessing right, no regular ship can reach that Astral sector. Maybe Eclipse only... But whimsical Catherina is the last Great Mage I would share my mission with. It's enough she has almost ruined the whole Sarnaut because of her unreasonable ambitions!

You remember that Elves were involved in the construction of Eclipse? They have also built the Darkblood Citadel! The one that has almost turned my allod to ashes. It may be slower than Eclipse, but it's definitely way more solid. I'm sure you and my assistants will reach Ferris on it with no problem. You will only have to deal with the vampires swarming inside of it, and with crackpot Amadeus. My apprentice, Herbert, will help you. He will also lead the surveyors' expedition to Ferris.

Unfortunately, I cannot leave Avilon and go with you. Herbert is young and ardent, and you will be his right hand and his wise counselor.

Now go! I believe in the success of the expedition!

I am a Great Mage. Maybe I'm not the strongest one, but I am the oldest. I remember our world being a single whole. I remember the horrors of the Cataclysm and the bloody years that followed. I saw cities coming down and houses burning, while thousands of mortals were dying for their governors' ambitions. When years and centuries pass you by and the world changes in front of your eyes, it is difficult to remain a detached observer, but I tried to... I do my best not to interfere! The ambitions of the Great Mages' have caused enough trouble to this world.

After I became a Historian, I swore not to interfere with the political affairs, not to play with the lives of mortals, and to stay away from the forbidden. My mission is to collect and to preserve. But can you imagine what will happen if the source of the divine power gets into the wrong hands?

And you... After all that you've been through, after you have faced the gods themselves, you will understand me better than anyone. This is why I'm asking you to help.

After those events Priden Golases completely sealed off their domain from the Astral net and isolated themselves from the rest of the world. This is why you don't usually see Pridens in the lands of the League or the Empire. They practically never leave their allod. But this is not the point.

It was not the legend that caught my interest, but Ferris itself. Don't you get it yet? Just think of it: somehow Tep gained almost a divine power. There is a projection of his own memories of the Shoom Pridens in his illusory world. Priden traitors joined the servants of the ancient summoner on an unknown allod. What conclusion can we draw? Ferris is the key to the understanding of the source of his power!

I wouldn't assert that Ferris is the place where Tep had gained his power. But something that happened there had been occupying his thoughts for sure. If we reach Ferris, we will find a key to this mystery!

Remember that mysterious amulet that I obtained after you returned from the captivity of illusions? I found out who it had belonged to. Long ago on Howlem, the distant land of Pridens, lived a tribe that Pridens called the Shoom Branch. One of Priden shamans - a doolga - told me that the Shoom Branch fell under the influence of Tep Cultists and was involved in one of his resurrection attempts, but eventually was obliterated by other Branches. It happened soon after the Shoom leader had discovered an ancient Portal that led to an allod unknown to Astralonauts. Pridens call it Ferris.

t:

Of course, I’ll be there. So I could at least make sure this power doesn’t end up in the wrong hands.

Ha ha! Wrong! I’m so lucky lucky lucky today! Let’s play once again, huh?
See the coin? This side is heads, the other side is tails. I flip it, I snip it, I turn it around, what’s your guess?
Hey, do you have a coin? No? You’re down and out too? Go find one first, then we’ll play.
Oh, so you like my sword, eh? Let’s play then, my sword, your gold. If you win, take the sword. If I win, your gold is mine. What do we play? Heads or Tails.

Oh, Miloslavin, he’s in prison. Stole something, I guess. He’s lucky not to have been kicked out into the Astral. It’s all thanks to the Queen’s protection. It was her order to consider him a native Umoirian - ah, let it be then. Our punishment for theft is cutting off arms! No pity to thiefs.

You’re devil, and your dark deeds and sins will drag you to the saddest of the sad places, you’ll see! Depriving poor people of their last copper coins! The gallow has long been missing Jade, can’t wait to hug his neck! You’ll see, he will drive you to hell, too!

Here. Tell him he’ll pay for his sins one day, oh yes, he will!

Freedom is my dream! I can see the day that my shackles will fall off, and I will rize! The world will lay in dust, and then it will be reborn! I will be avenged, and my enemies will pay for everything!

Noone can stop me! Decide now, what you want - eternal life or oblivion?

t:
Oh you’ve made a nice tangle, haven’t you? Haven’t I warned you to choose sides carefully? So what are you going to do now?

Do you think defeating an evil god and obtaining the godly power is what it takes? Of course... NOT! All the force that you’ve got will never outpower the real thing!

No, the real thing to fear is not Sarn. He’s safely shackled, don’t thank me. What threatens your world, is dark, huge and deadly. Even I wouldn’t mess with it! But now I’ll just step back and enjoy the view! I love tragedy!
Gather up forces! Call in for everybody, whether they are good or evil, for what is coming, is a hundred times more dangerous!

Truly amazing things you saw! Sarn and Nihaz... No, I never heard these names before. You say, they are the gods who created our world? Never heard of them, I tell thee.

Don’t be upset. Visions are nothing more than just visions. There were no such gods here. No Sarn, no Nihaz, no Tensess, only emptiness, deep black Nothingness looked me in the eye.

The only thing is quite clear: either to start or to stop the Leper can only a god, and nobody else. To tell you the truth, I thought it was Catherina at first, but no, she’s unable to.

Why would gods get angry with us? Why punish? What are our sins?..
r177337.n: Tell about your visions of the future

t:
Living gems, you say? You mean those I gave to druids as a thank you for healing my little brother?

You cannot find any more of these. I had a gold mine, that could give a gem or two once in a while, that’s true, but no such living gems never existed there.

They way I obtained the Prophetic Ruby, that living gem you’re asking of, was pretty weird. My people came to me in horror once, and asked me to go down the shaft.

I descended, alone, for noone wanted to keep me company - they all were too scared. I saw a crack in the wall, all in green smoke and light, and there was a tiny lizard on the stone. She spoke to me, saying she had a gift for me. Then she waved her tail and disappeared, leaving a pile of precious glittering gems.

I took them and left. What it was, I do not know. And the Ruby served me well, see?
r177350.n: Ask Goldie about the living gems

t:
No human could do such harm. Whoever did this, I don’t know. There is great magic being done in the Astral. No godly magic, no Light, no dragon’s magic - it has come from another world! I don’t know whether it’s for the good or for the bad, either.

I can see how much you care about Umoir. Try and talk to Catherina. Make her stop following and persecuting the true believers, the old druids. She cannot stand alone. Tell her about the strange magic.
You are not the only one who calls upon us!
r177384.n: You are not the only one who calls upon us!

t: I have many things to do, as well as you! Send my cheers to Catherina!

Disgust and disgrace. It’s worse that the Plague or demons - they merely killed, that’s all. The Leper transforms, changes... corrupts! Corrupts in the way, presupposed by somebody.

It’s funny, you know. You don’t often ask me questions, and now that you do, I cannot give you a reply! I don’t know who started the Leper. I have no idea how to stop it. I can only keep it within the limits, though I’m far from saving Umoir... But I will! Some day I will!

It’s a simple question. They’re here, because I brought them here. You have no idea how much power the Tep’s Spark conceals - however, less than it used to! How tempting it is! I cannot entrust it neither to Aidenus, nor to Yasker or Zayan, not even Holy Zosim. It will remain here, heat the cold stone, help the trees grow and grant life to those, deprived of it by Tep.

This was the first echo of the upcoming war. There were no enemies, no alliances, no armies, but the war was inevitable.

But you have another path to follow, so walk your way! Become strong. Keep your weapons ready. Look out. Protect, when the time comes.
r177448.n: Ask about the Servant of Light

t: Of course, of course, it’s high time! I think you need to lead the process, for you’re the only one who knows and brings the truth! Stand right there and give us orders! Be careful with the snow, it doesn’t seem to like being sculptured and always turns into aggressive monsters.
Why, sure! But those old beggars are still in doubt...
See, I was right! You weren’t that wrong, eather. Let’s do it now.

r177562.n: I am happy to see you again.

t:
That’s a thing to thank for! We haven’t seen much of you after the Crystal Palace had fallen. The wise men say, before the grief comes, the city won’t know its hero! Look at me, I’m a simple blacksmith, not a leader. When we appeared in this frozen place, everyone went crazy. Some just stood there, others were running in circles and screaming... I had to take the leadership.

As long as there are only two of us, let’s sit down and think, how to get back home. Oh, before we do that, can you do us a favor, please? The damned monkeys stole our belongings and buried them down in the hollow. Please help us find our things! We're not that rich now to leave them scattered.
Isn’t he cutey cute? So fluffy, so soft, and look at his whiskers! And paws, and tail! Want to pat him, don’t you?

Oh bliss! Oh oranges! This smell and color, and juiciness! No gem will ever compare you you, oh orange! But I’m humbly asking you, hero, to accept this gold as reward. If you can save more oranges, bring them in! Every seed counts!

These monkeys are so sly and fast! While you chase one, it throws the orange to another one, and another! But your legs are longer, and there are two of you, so you will do better. Save as many oranges as you can. We won’t survive without them.
I guess, you’re right, we have no other options. Okay, you may talk to him, but make sure to visit the church after we’ve returned!
This is hereticism! Just look at it, all green and blue, like the Leper. What good can it be?
You’re persistent, aren’t you? Catherina will know all about this.
How can you do this! Helping erect the idol, summon the false god, talk to it! Return this dirty crocodile, where it belongs. I hope you are sorry about that.

Now you’re talking, we always need a hand here. Take the forage, feed the hens - they’re always pecking at my feet, I hate it.
That was fast. Thank you. Tell Mira, we’re even.
Good day! What are you looking for?

If you won’t give her the easy way, I’ll give you the hard way!
I’ve got the horse, right? It means that the harness is mine, too, and the briddle, and the saddle, and the girl!
I owe some money to our gardener, Zakhar Curoed. Go to him and work it off.

Come again, what exactly do you want? My Roanie?! Would you also like a key to my tower, where I keep my jewels, huh?

Alright, alright! You can have it. I’ll give it to you, as soon as you will have performed my three tasks.
There are some lazy bones! They don’t plough, don’t plant, just wander around. The Empire, they say, sends them to exile. We’re not so cruel, so just teach them a little lesson, beat them hard!
Not bad, not bad at all. I’m too old to lift heavy bags and cut the hay... Now to your second task...
It’s the most difficult one... Listen.
Wohoa, look at that, how they rush into the field!
Keep dreaming! Take the broom, it’ll do for the horse!

She put them to prison, executed, punished in all possible and impossible manners. And then the Leper came. Common people grumbled and raged, and suffered a big deal. On the one hand, there was Catherina with her sanctions. On the other hand, there were wicked creatures from the corrupted forest. People chose for the Leper and fled to the woods.

These amulets keep the old gods’ power. Nevermind they are ancient and weak, and unable to fight the Light. Their might is safely stored in the amulets, and if you manage to find them all, I will tell you another story...

I can’t rouse them - they are having a nightmare but can’t wake up. You’re quite an expert in dreams now, can you do anything? I feel sorry for the guys, I’ve become quite attached.

t:
Our orc shamans learned that I was alive - rumors spread quickly, after all. Perhaps some demonologist blurted it out, or they had a vision... doesn’t matter, really. They came to me. Cried, fell to their knees, hugged me! Pshaw!

“The hope of the orcs is alive again” and all that. I show them the door, meaning I don’t want any part of that. They change their tune then. “How about you help us train young orcs with special abilities, Skulnar?” they say. And I ask, “What kind of abilities?” It turns out our shamans have been watching those with highly developed perception. Well, those who can predict the future. They are supposed to be the descendants of that Legendary Orc but they’re nowhere as strong as he was. It’s just a smidge - they are luckier in cards and can dodge a stray arrow.
